$comment: Frictionless Table Schema v1. Helper input: aggregated in the browser to kpi_history.
name: orders_export
title: Order-level export
description: One row per order. FOSIT maps shipping_zip to geo_id and aggregates to date x geo. Nothing leaves the browser.

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 timestamp; only the date part (as written) is used.

fields.name: shipping_zip
fields.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4. 3-4 digit values are left-padded with zeros (spreadsheets often strip them) and reported.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: Optional; if present, duplicate order_ids are dropped and reported.
